brand.tagline: Fatigue and crash alerts for jeepney drivers and their families

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to see your vehicle and alerts.
signIn.joinPrompt: Have a code from a driver?

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: For drivers. You will add your vehicle next.

join.title: Join with a code
join.subtitle: Enter the code the driver shared with you.
join.invalidTitle: We could not open this invitation

accept.title: Follow {{name}}
accept.intro: {{name}} invited you to follow their alerts in Alerto. This is what {{name}} shares with you:
accept.note: {{name}} can change what is shared, or remove the link, at any time.

notify.title: Allow notifications
notify.intro: Alerto can tell you right away about {{name}}'s alerts, even when the app is closed. You will be notified when:
notify.sent: The crash message is sent, or the driver cancels it

tip.title: Add Alerto to your home screen
tip.intro: Open Alerto faster and full screen, like any other app.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a code.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we have sent a reset code. It may take a few minutes.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
errors.invalidLogin: The email or password is not correct. Please try again.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.
errors.codeRequired: Enter the code from the driver.
errors.codeNotFound: We could not find that code. Check it and try again.
errors.codeUsed: This code has already been used. Ask the driver for a new one.
